Or stage some natural disaster? That'd motivate them to leave the place on their own accord.''"
"''We've actually gamed that out. It gets unpredictable very quickly.|Daysar and Moy|audio=WhyNotHaveAPlague-OneYearLater.flac|}} '''Moy''' was a [[human]] [[Imperial officer]] with the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[lieutenant]] in the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial Security Bureau]] (ISB). They were part of a group of Imperials selected by [[Director of Advanced Weapons Research|Director]] [[Orson Callan Krennic|Orson Krennic]] for the [[Ghorman project]], an effort to ensure the Empire's control over the [[planet]] [[Ghorman]] in order to [[Mining|mine]] it. The lieutenant oversaw simulations for methods of relocating the [[Ghorman (people)|Ghorman people]]. In [[4 BBY]], the people under the Ghorman project were gathered by Krennic in the [[Maltheen Divide]] for a [[Maltheen Divide conference|full briefing]] on their goal, as well as discussion on the challenges they faced for it. Afterward, Moy spoke with [[Admiral]] [[Daysar]], mentioning the simulations upon the latter's suggestion of starting a natural disaster or plague. In [[3 BBY]], Moy joined Krennic, some [[ISB Supervisor]]s, and other guests for a tour of the [[banker]] [[Davo Sculdun]]'s [[Davo Sculdun's gallery|gallery]]. During the tour, the lieutenant watched as Krennic engaged in an intensifying debate with [[Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]]. In [[1 BBY]], Moy passed forward news of the [[death]] of [[Luthen Rael]]—a suspected [[Axis network|rebel spy]] in Imperial custody—to Krennic, interrupting the [[director]]'s interrogation of ISB Supervisor [[Dedra Meero]]. ==Biography== ===The Ghorman project=== {{Quote|No notes. No records. None of you were here. Nobody puts this in their calendar. All service and transport droids will be data-wiped, once we're done. Your colleagues, superiors… if they're not in this room, they're not cleared for the project. Colonel Yularen, Governor Tarkin, all senior commanders will be notified by the Emperor, at the time of his choosing. Now, the group in this room is, of this moment, the tightest of closed circles. Any security violation will be brought to the Emperor's personal attention.|Orson Krennic instructs discretion to Moy and the other attendees in the Maltheen Divide|audio=SecretProject-OYL.mp3|}} [[File:Moy-meeting-Andor201.png|thumb|left|300px|Moy was selected to be part of the Ghorman project.]] During the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], Moy served in the Empire's [[Imperial Security Bureau]] (ISB), reaching the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[lieutenant]]. In [[4 BBY]], they were one of a handful of Imperials working with [[Director of Advanced Weapons Research|Director]] [[Orson Callan Krennic|Orson Krennic]] on the [[Ghorman project]], an initiative by Krennic to increase Imperial control over the [[planet]] [[Ghorman]] in order to extract vital [[kalkite]] from the surface. The kalkite was required for the construction of Krennic's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]],''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' which was being fronted as [[Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine's]] "[[Project Celestial Power|energy project]]" for the time being. The [[mining]] of the kalkite was feared to destabilize the planet's core, and, as such, the population needed to be handled in methods created by the project. Hypothetical scenarios for Ghorman population control ran by Moy included the use of natural disasters or plagues, the results establishing that their use would become unpredictable very quickly. Moy was summoned to a [[Maltheen Divide conference|secret meeting]] chaired by Krennic in the [[Maltheen Divide]] to discuss next steps for the removal of the Ghormans. There, the [[director]] explained the meeting's secrecy; there would be no records or notes, and any violation of security within the group would be brought to Palpatine's personal attention. Krennic then played to the room a [[Unidentified Ghorman holodocumentary|Ghorman holodocumentary]], which detailed the world's [[Ghorman twill]] and [[Ghorman silk|silk]] industry and the [[Spider|arachnid]] [[ghorlectipod]]s that made it, and Krennic revealed afterward the Empire's need for the planet's kalkite. [[File:Moy-explains-Andor201.png|thumb|right|300px|Moy speaks with Admiral Daysar.]] Discussion further ensued on the logistics of the mining and dealing with resistance from the Ghorman populace, the attendees being informed they would be responsible for dealing with any military and [[propaganda]] efforts required against the world's visibility and [[Politics|political]] power on the [[Galaxy|galactic]] stage. Afterward, the attendees had a break for some refreshments and [[Foodstuff|food]]. Moy spoke with [[Admiral]] [[Daysar]], who pondered the possibility of using a plague or natural disaster to deter Ghormans from their homeworld. The lieutenant chimed in that they had gamed that out already. [[ISB Supervisor]] [[Dedra Meero]] was ultimately put in charge of the Ghorman project.{{Andor|Sagrona Teema}} ===Krennic dilemmas=== {{Quote|If you have a moment…|Moy summons Orson Krennic|{{Andor|Who Else Knows?}}}} In [[3 BBY]],{{AndorDate|206}} Moy attended an [[Davo Sculdun's party|Investiture party]] on{{Andor|What a Festive Evening}} the Imperial [[capital]] planet [[Coruscant]], hosted by the [[Chandrilan]] [[banker]] [[Davo Sculdun]]. At the [[Sculdun Tower|venue]], the lieutenant and a handful of other select guests were invited by Sculdun to see his personal [[Davo Sculdun's gallery|art gallery]], including Krennic, three ISB Supervisors, the [[antiques dealer]] [[Luthen Rael]], [[Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]], and more. Moy joined the majority of the group, which was shown artifacts around the room by Sculdun. Over the course of the tour, Mothma and Krennic exchanged thinly veiled taunts at one another. As their debate became more pronounced, Moy and ISB Supervisor [[Avril Heert]] exchanged looks multiple times. The group soon reached the [[Tinian Codex]] artifact, where ISB Supervisor [[Lonni Jung]] and Rael's [[Aide|assistant]] [[Kleya Marki]] had been. Jung explained the significance of the codex, Krennic using one of the facts to taunt Mothma again, bringing laughter from the rest of the group. [[File:Enter-Moy-Andor211.png|thumb|left|300px|Moy interrupts Orson Krennic's interrogation of Dedra Meero.]] In [[1 BBY]],{{AndorDate|211}} Meero found evidence to suggest that Rael had been a [[Axis network|rebel]] [[spy]] she had been tracking down for some time. She attempted to [[Raid on the Galactic Antiquities and Objects of Interest|arrest]] Rael, who stabbed himself and was taken into intensive care in the [[Lina Soh Hospital]] under Imperial custody. Marki, however, infiltrated the hospital and [[Death|killed]] Rael, burying his secrets with him. Meanwhile, Meero was arrested and questioned by Krennic over a leak of information on the [[Death Star]] that had made its way to Rael and his assistant. Moy arrived at the interrogation room with an [[ISB Attendant]] and interrupted the interview. Outside the room, the lieutenant gave Krennic the news of Rael's death. ==Personality and traits== [[File:Moy-watches-Andor206.png|thumb|right|300px|Moy rarely diverged from their formal composure.]] Moy kept composed in front of their colleagues, maintaining a neutral expression even during less formal gatherings. When the lieutenant and Supervisor Heert exchanged looks during Orson Krennic and Mon Mothma's debating, Moy retained their neutral composure. The ISB [[officer]] was sure to interrupt Krennic's interrogation of Dedra Meero to pass on the news of Luthen Rael's death. A [[human]], Moy had light skin, [[Color|black]] [[hair]], and brown [[eye]]s. ==Equipment== Moy wore a white [[Imperial officer's uniform]] with black breeches, a black [[belt]], two [[code cylinder]]s, and a [[rank insignia plaque]] with three blue tiles. At the investiture party, Moy's [[Clothing|uniform]] was decorated with silver features on their shoulders and collar, with a middle white stripe along their black belt. They also donned black [[glove]]s when bringing Krennic the news of Rael's death. ==Behind the scenes== Moy debuted in "[[One Year Later]]," the premier episode of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', which aired on [[April 22]], [[2025]].{{InsiderCite|233|Andor Season 2 Companion|''Andor'' Season 2 Companion}} Footage of the character was revealed beforehand in the first trailer for the season, published on the official ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Wikipedia:YouTube|YouTube]] channel on [[February 24]] of that year.{{SWYouTube|AE4wxt70aUM|Andor | Season 2 Trailer | Streaming April 22 on Disney+}} Moy was portrayed by actor [[Jos Slovick]]. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Moy|soundcat=Audio files of Moy}} *{{Andor|One Year Later}} {{1st}} *{{Andor|What a Festive Evening}} *{{Andor|Who Else Knows?}} ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|AE4wxt70aUM|Andor | Season 2 Trailer | Streaming April 22 on Disney+}} {{1stp}} *{{SWYouTube|feJSTZRRaFQ|Andor Season 2 | Special Look | Streaming April 22 on Disney+|int=Andor Season 2: A Special Look}} *{{SWYouTube|duN-KQgOjYs|Andor | Official Trailer | Final Season Streaming April 22 on Disney+}} *{{SWYouTube|f6UQ_lPBUhU|Andor Season 2 | The Tightest of Closed Circles | Now Streaming on Disney+}} *{{SWYouTube|3ihBfycg8Wg|Andor Season 2 Declassified: World Building | Contains Spoilers Eps 4-6}} *{{SWYouTube|B-sI-Iz_zyo|Andor Season 2 Declassified: Farewell | Contains Spoilers Eps 10-12}} *{{SWYouTube|QeHqncitix0|Mon Mothma Offical Compilation | Andor Season 2}} *{{SWYouTube|t7TRdJ27wn4|Director Krennic Official Compilation | Andor Season 2}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Moy |ja=モイ |ka=მოი }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Imperial Security Bureau officers]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
